resolution.note: fast derives CLI-subprocess coverage from src/cli/index.ts command imports

title: fast derives the src modules a bin/krn subprocess test covers
body:
Why: t-2y7e1mz (79cfa38) fixed the fast miss for src/repo/contract.ts by adding manual `// fast-covers: src/repo/contract.ts` headers to three CLI-subprocess tests; any other src module reached only through bin/krn subprocesses still needs a hand-written header, and a missing one passes fast silently.
Outcome: fast derives CLI-subprocess coverage automatically (a test that spawns bin/krn <command> covers the src modules that command's CLI entry imports, transitively), or a check fails when a test spawning bin/krn lacks a fast-covers header for the modules it asserts.
Proof: test/fast-check.test.ts asserts the derived selection for one more module without a manual header.
